common: Photorealistic high-end furnished interior, landscape 3:2. Camera straight-on perpendicular to back wall. Very bright neutral daytime interior, large windows and white linen curtains bounce abundant diffuse daylight directly onto the entire central wall. Central wall must look brightly illuminated, almost luminous, without harsh direct sun patches or dramatic shadows. Lighting should match a brightly photographed richly textured painting later composited onto wall. EMPTY central wall from x40 to60 percent, y10 to54 percent. NO paintings, frames, wall art, placeholders, text, watermark. Console top at y62 percent, objects only outside central x40..60 area, below y54. Realistic comfortable furnishing, sophisticated and personal, no clutter.

scenes.carnations: Light blush-white plaster sitting room, pale oak slim console, ivory curved chair lower left with forest green cushion, a little pink glass and ceramic bowl at far right, airy olive tree at far right, floor to ceiling window at left. Bright soft light from left and front.
scenes.navy: Airy elegant study, very light pearl gray wall, walnut writing console, blue upholstered reading chair lower right, small bronze lamp unlit far left on console, books far right, large left window with sheer linen. Abundant cool neutral soft daylight, no moody lighting.
scenes.sahara: Bright ivory architectural dining nook, pale travertine console, edge of oak round table and chair lower left, brass bowl far left console and black ceramic vase far right, slim branches far right, generous right window. Bright neutral diffuse light from right and front.
scenes.verdant: Airy garden sitting room, light warm ivory plaster central wall, dark oak console, moss green chair lower left, small gold bowl far left console and low ceramic vessel far right, greenery at far right edge, broad left window. Very bright neutral soft daylight on wall, no amber or dark mood.
scenes.ciaran: Light cream-sage elegant entry, slim walnut console, cream stool underneath, burgundy shallow bowl far left console and small ceramic vessel far right, tall tree far left edge, broad right window with white linen curtains. Abundant bright neutral daylight from right and front, luminous wall.
